dsi:intent/accent: Brand or primary emphasis that draws attention without signaling status; not general-purpose; not highlight (marks a region the user is focusing on).
dsi:intent/caution: Status: a milder level of warning; worth noticing, unlikely to cause harm; not warning (status).
dsi:intent/danger: Status: something is wrong, failed or at risk; not general-purpose.
dsi:intent/discovery: Marks something new or changed that invites exploration: new features, onboarding, promotion. Not a status and not a warning; not accent (brand or primary emphasis that draws attention without signaling status).
dsi:intent/highlight: Marks a region the user is focusing on, editing or has selected as text, without status or brand meaning; not general-purpose; not accent (brand or primary emphasis that draws attention without signaling status).
dsi:intent/info: Status: informational, no action required; not general-purpose.
dsi:intent/neutral: Deliberately carries no status or brand meaning; not general-purpose; not highlight (marks a region the user is focusing on).
dsi:intent/success: Status: completed or positive outcome; not general-purpose.
dsi:intent/warning: Status: needs attention; something may go wrong; not caution (status).
none:intent: Not specific to this dimension; not neutral (deliberately carries no status or brand meaning); not highlight (marks a region the user is focusing on).
dsi:usage/on-fill: Content placed on a filled background, where it must contrast with that fill; not general-purpose; not categorical (a set of distinct colors assigned to identities or series).
dsi:usage/surface: Containers placed on the page: cards, panels, layers; not general-purpose; not page (the outermost application background behind all surfaces).
dsi:usage/overlay: Content floating above the page: menus, popovers, modals; not general-purpose; not state layer (a translucent overlay showing interaction state (hover).
dsi:usage/state-layer: A translucent overlay showing interaction state (hover, pressed); not general-purpose; not overlay (content floating above the page).
dsi:usage/code-surface: The surfaces of code blocks and editors: background, gutter, line numbers, highlighted lines and diff lines; not general-purpose.
dsi:usage/categorical: A set of distinct colors assigned to identities or series, where each member is a different color, not a level; not general-purpose; not surface (containers placed on the page).
dsi:usage/field: Form inputs: text fields, selects, text areas; not general-purpose.
dsi:usage/heading: Text that titles content; not title (medium-emphasis headings for sections).
dsi:usage/navigation: Application navigation chrome: side nav, top bar; not surface (containers placed on the page); not general-purpose.
dsi:usage/page: The outermost application background behind all surfaces; not surface (containers placed on the page); not general-purpose.
none:usage: Not specific to this dimension; not surface (containers placed on the page); not on fill (content placed on a filled background).
dsi:hue/brown: Low-saturation warm hue around 25°, darker than orange; not yellow (hue around 55°).
dsi:hue/cyan: Hue around 190°; not teal (hue around 170°); not general-purpose.
dsi:hue/gray: Neutral: no dominant hue (includes cool and warm grays); not general-purpose.
dsi:hue/yellow: Hue around 55°; not brown (low-saturation warm hue around 25°); not general-purpose.
none:hue: Not specific to this dimension; not orange (hue around 30°); not green (hue around 120°).
dsi:property/background: Fill behind content: surfaces, containers, fills; not general-purpose.
dsi:property/border: Borders, dividers and outlines that are part of layout; not focus ring (the outline drawn around an element that has keyboard focus).
dsi:property/foreground: Text and icons together: one token colors both; not text (text color only. a token that colors both text and icons binds foreground instead); not general-purpose.
dsi:property/icon: The color or size of icons and other small symbolic graphics; not general-purpose.
dsi:property/text: Text color only. A token that colors both text and icons binds foreground instead; not foreground (text and icons together); not general-purpose.
dsi:property/focus-ring: The outline drawn around an element that has keyboard focus; not border (borders).
none:property: Not specific to this dimension; not icon (the color or size of icons and other small symbolic graphics); not background (fill behind content).
dsi:emphasis/strong: A step stronger than the default, contrasting more with the page than the default member of its family; not general-purpose; not stronger (the step between strong and strongest in an emphasis family).
dsi:emphasis/strongest: The strongest step of an emphasis family that has more than three steps; not general-purpose; not stronger (the step between strong and strongest in an emphasis family).
dsi:emphasis/subtle: A step weaker than the default, contrasting less with the page than the default member of its family; not general-purpose; not subtler (the step between subtlest and subtle in an emphasis family).
dsi:emphasis/subtlest: The weakest step of an emphasis family that has more than three steps; not general-purpose; not subtle (a step weaker than the default).
dsi:emphasis/subtler: The step between subtlest and subtle in an emphasis family; not subtle (a step weaker than the default); not general-purpose.
dsi:emphasis/stronger: The step between strong and strongest in an emphasis family; not strong (a step stronger than the default); not general-purpose.
none:emphasis: Not specific to this dimension; not strong (a step stronger than the default); not subtle (a step weaker than the default).
dsi:state/hover: The state of an element while a pointer rests over it; not general-purpose.
dsi:state/focus: The state of an element while it receives keyboard or programmatic input; not general-purpose.
dsi:state/selected: The state of an element that the user has chosen from a set; not general-purpose.
none:state: Not specific to this dimension; not focus (the state of an element while it receives keyboard or programmatic input); not hover (the state of an element while a pointer rests over it).
